user.title: DomoLink-Tado Connection
user.description:
Please link your Tado account using the secure Device Flow protocol.

1. Open: **{verification_uri}**
2. Enter the following code if prompted: **{user_code}**
3. Confirm access on your Tado account, then click **Submit** below.
